report_title: ETR Review — Auckland Pure-Land Buy-and-Hold Recommendation
user_requirements: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW of DRAFT_12LIST.md — a shortlist of 12 Auckland land-bank purchase options in the $1.3M-$1.8M band, each of which will become its own client-facing PDF profile with listing photos for a family purchase decision. BUYER_CONTEXT.md is ground truth (do not re-litigate). CORRIDOR_NORTH.md, CORRIDOR_NORTHWEST.md, CORRIDOR_SOUTH.md, CANDIDATES.md, HOBSON_RD_DD.md and FINAL_RECOMMENDATION-era facts embedded in the draft are the evidence base, gathered 1 Nov 2026 from live listings, agent re-verification, and direct GIS point queries of Auckland Council's operative Unitary Plan services. Review on six axes: (1) RANKING LOGIC — is the Tier A / Tier B split and the 1-12 order defensible from the evidence? Would you reorder, and exactly why? Is any Tier B property actually stronger than a Tier A one on probability-weighted uplift per dollar? (2) EVIDENCE TIERS — the draft marks each property FUZ-GIS / FUZ-stated / CSL / RP. Verify the draft never lets a weaker evidence tier borrow the credibility of a stronger one in its wording, and that every $/m2, CV, staleness figure and tactic traces to the corpus. Flag any arithmetic errors ($/m2 calcs especially). (3) BAND DISCIPLINE — the band is $1.3M-$1.8M GST-settled. Which of the 12 are at genuine risk of clearing above band (18 Riverlea tender, 60 Harry Dodd CV $1.875M, 540 Runciman CV $2.0M, 106 Pukekohe East top-of-estimate) and does the draft price that risk honestly? Should any be cut for band risk and a reserve promoted? (4) DEFECT SCREEN — pylons/transmission lines killed three prior candidates (photo-evidenced). Does each of the 12 have an explicit pylon/flood/wet-ground statement? Which candidates still carry UNRESOLVED physical-defect flags (145A Runciman gully, 60 Harry Dodd watercourse, 540 Runciman pond, 175 Oraha flood-map timing) and are those flagged loudly enough for a family audience? (5) CARRY + EXIT HONESTY — bare land has negative carry and the Dairy Flat subset (79 Follies, 7 Bobs, 28 Durey) rides the 2050+ sequencing unless mid-2027 policy intervenes; is that deep-time risk stated with equal force on every Dairy Flat profile, and are the exit comps (Whenuapai $245-257/m2 transacted; Dairy Flat englobo ~$127/m2 historical) applied to the right properties only? (6) COMPLETENESS — do the 12 plus reserves cover the evidence base's best options, or is anything in the corpus unfairly excluded (92 Adams scale wildcard, 12 Cheriton over-band call, 68 Potter unresolved $1.85M sale record)? Output: numbered findings, each with severity (BLOCKING / MAJOR / MINOR), the exact property/claim affected, and the exact correction. End with: (a) a per-property verdict line for ALL 12 — KEEP / KEEP-WITH-CORRECTIONS / REPLACE (and with which reserve); (b) the corrected 1-12 ranking if different; (c) an overall GO / CONDITIONAL_GO / NO_GO for shipping the 12 PDF profiles to the family. Be strict; this is the only automated gate before the PDFs are built.
acquirer_context: Buyer is a hands-on NZ multi-business operator buying with his father; expects strict, decisive, dense output with no hedging filler. Capital at risk ~$1.5M plus 7-15 years of holding costs. The family decision meeting will stress-test the rejection of the father's preferred property hardest — that section must be unassailable or the whole document fails its purpose. Low appetite for unpriced tail risk; zero appetite for unverified listing claims (two prior burns on sold listings). All listings referenced were verified active 1 Nov 2026; flag any reliance that ages badly (deadline sales, auctions) with explicit dates.
